from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['calibrate_affine_gauges', 'align_reference_features', 'fit_predict_yield_gated_creep']


def calibrate_affine_gauges(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray,
                           check_group: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, *,
                           stress_scale: float, prior: np.ndarray | None = None,
                           consensus_span: float = 0.10, residual_tol: float = 0.001,
                           spot_tol: float = 0.02, spot_span: float = 0.50
                           ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return physical [gain, bias] maps and a strict-majority support mask.

    Each group has a positive affine gauge. Stress tolerances are fractions of
    stress_scale; priors have physical biases in the same units as measured.
    Pass the latest independently supported archive map per group as prior,
    or use nominal [1, 0]. Without a supported sweep, update only the prior
    bias unless at least two compatible spots span spot_span and support a
    positive gain. Neither spot update counts as strict-majority support.
    There is no ridge; the prior restricts fallback updates instead.
    """
    params = np.array([stress_scale, consensus_span, residual_tol, spot_tol, spot_span])
    if not np.isfinite(params).all() or not (stress_scale > 0 and
            0 < consensus_span <= spot_span and 0 < residual_tol <= spot_tol):
        raise ValueError('invalid calibration scale or tolerances')
    x = np.asarray(command, float) / stress_scale
    y = np.asarray(measured, float) / stress_scale
    labels, groups = np.asarray(check_group), np.asarray(groups)
    if x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or labels.shape != x.shape or groups.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected matched check vectors and a group vector')
    maps = np.tile([1., 0.], (len(groups), 1)) if prior is None else np.array(prior, float, copy=True)
    if maps.shape != (len(groups), 2) or not np.isfinite(maps).all() or np.any(maps[:, 0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('expected a finite positive-gain prior per group')
    maps[:, 1] /= stress_scale
    supported = np.zeros(len(groups), bool)
    finite = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    for k, group in enumerate(groups):
        take = finite & (labels == group)
        a, b = x[take], y[take]
        order = np.lexsort((b, a))
        a, b = a[order], b[order]
        design = np.column_stack((a, np.ones(a.size)))
        minimum = max(3, a.size // 2 + 1)
        best = None
        if a.size >= minimum and np.ptp(a) >= consensus_span:
            i, j = np.triu_indices(a.size, 1)
            wide = a[j] - a[i] >= consensus_span
            for u, v in zip(i[wide], j[wide]):
                gain = (b[v] - b[u]) / (a[v] - a[u])
                if gain <= 0:
                    continue
                keep = np.abs(b - b[u] - gain * (a - a[u])) <= residual_tol
                if keep.sum() < minimum:
                    continue
                line = np.linalg.lstsq(design[keep], b[keep], rcond=None)[0]
                error = b - design @ line
                use = np.abs(error) <= residual_tol
                count = int(use.sum())
                if line[0] <= 0 or count < minimum or np.ptp(a[use]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                score = (-count, float(error[use] @ error[use]))
                if best is None or score < best:
                    best, maps[k], supported[k] = score, line, True
        if not supported[k]:
            delta = b - design @ maps[k]
            close = np.abs(delta) <= spot_tol
            if close.sum() >= 2 and np.ptp(a[close]) >= spot_span:
                line = np.linalg.lstsq(design[close], b[close], rcond=None)[0]
                if line[0] > 0:
                    maps[k] = line
                    continue
            if close.any():
                maps[k, 1] += np.median(delta[close])
    maps[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return maps, supported


def align_reference_features(raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray,
                             group: np.ndarray, stratum: np.ndarray
                             ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned/imputed features and a pre-imputation completeness mask.

    The signal and reference panel share a positive group-affine transform.
    Supply permitted unlabeled reference rows, including evaluation rows when
    the protocol allows it. Alignment uses the median reference column mean
    and median population SD from columns with at least two finite values.
    Imputation averages observed cell means equally per feature. There is no
    scale floor or shrinkage: reject unsupported panels and features.
    """
    x = np.array(raw, float, copy=True)
    ref = np.asarray(reference, float)
    group, stratum = np.asarray(group), np.asarray(stratum)
    if (x.ndim != 2 or not all(x.shape) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x)
            or group.shape != (len(x),) or stratum.shape != group.shape):
        raise ValueError('expected matched nonempty signal, reference and label rows')
    _, g = np.unique(group, return_inverse=True)
    _, s = np.unique(stratum, return_inverse=True)
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    for label in np.unique(g):
        rows = g == label
        panel = ref[rows]
        finite = np.isfinite(panel)
        cols = finite.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not cols.any():
            raise ValueError('group has no supported reference column')
        panel = np.where(finite[:, cols], panel[:, cols], np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(center) or not np.isfinite(scale) or scale <= 0:
            raise ValueError('group requires a finite reference center and positive scale')
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / scale
    cells, inv = np.unique(np.column_stack((g, s)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    inv = inv.reshape(-1)
    count = np.zeros((len(cells), x.shape[1]))
    total = np.zeros_like(count)
    np.add.at(count, inv, observed)
    np.add.at(total, inv, np.where(observed, x, 0.))
    support = (count > 0).sum(axis=0)
    if np.any(support == 0):
        raise ValueError('a feature has no observed cell mean')
    means = np.divide(total, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
    return np.where(observed, x, means.sum(axis=0) / support), observed.all(axis=1)


def fit_predict_yield_gated_creep(history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray,
                                 durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray,
                                 initial_strain: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray,
                                 complete: np.ndarray, training: np.ndarray,
                                 strain_observed: np.ndarray, rate_observed: np.ndarray, *,
                                 time_scale: float, stress_scale: float, strain_scale: float,
                                 yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float],
                                 noise_floor: float = 1e-5, robust_cutoff: float = 3.,
                                 rank_rtol: float = 1e-8
                                 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit ordered two-mode creep and predict strain and onset for all rows.

    Stress is already calibrated. History (n,h) lists piecewise-constant
    intervals oldest first, with shared durations (h,) and zero initial
    memory. Hold is constant. Evaluation times (k,) are shared. Features
    (n,p) are aligned and filled; complete records original completeness.
    Fit only finite observations on complete training rows. A finite onset
    on an incomplete nontraining row supplies only a linear drift correction.

    Normalize by supplied time, stress and strain scales. Profile linear
    coefficients out of bounded multistart optimization, then perform five
    reweighting passes using a MAD per curve time and one for onset. The
    dimensionless MAD floor is 1e-5 and the residual cutoff is 3 MAD by
    default. No coefficient ridge or imputed-training fallback is used.
    Reject unidentified active fits or nonzero prediction terms not excited
    in the fitted observations.

    Return (taus, hereditary_weights, plastic_weights, strain, onset_rate)
    in physical units. Hereditary weights are two strain/stress amplitudes
    then drift intercept and slopes (strain/time). Plastic weights are
    strain/(stress**2*time) and strain/(stress**3*time), respectively.
    """
    scales = np.array([time_scale, stress_scale, strain_scale, yield_stress,
                       noise_floor, robust_cutoff, rank_rtol])
    if not np.isfinite(scales).all() or np.any(scales <= 0) or rank_rtol >= 1:
        raise ValueError('invalid physical or fit scales')
    h0, p0, d, t, e0, x, eps, rate = [np.asarray(a, float) for a in
        (history, hold, durations, times, initial_strain, features, strain_observed, rate_observed)]
    complete, training = np.asarray(complete, bool), np.asarray(training, bool)
    n = p0.size
    if (not n or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (p0, e0, rate, complete, training))
            or d.ndim != 1 or h0.shape != (n, d.size) or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size
            or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or eps.shape != (n, t.size)):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent specimen arrays or time grids')
    lo, hi = np.asarray(tau_bounds, float) / time_scale
    if (not 0 < lo < hi < np.inf or not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (h0, p0, d, t, e0, x))
            or np.any(d < 0) or t[0] < 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) <= 0)):
        raise ValueError('invalid relaxation bounds or physical inputs')
    h, p, d, t = h0 / stress_scale, p0 / stress_scale, d / time_scale, t / time_scale
    ov = (np.maximum(np.abs(p0) - yield_stress, 0.) / stress_scale)**2 * np.sign(p0)
    work = ((np.maximum(np.abs(h0) - yield_stress, 0.) / stress_scale)**2 @ d) * p
    cov = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    nh = cov.shape[1] + 2
    rate_unit = strain_scale / time_scale
    eps, rate = (eps - e0[:, None]) / strain_scale, rate / rate_unit
    use = training & complete
    cr, ck = np.nonzero(use[:, None] & np.isfinite(eps))
    rr = np.flatnonzero(use & np.isfinite(rate))
    if not cr.size or not rr.size:
        raise ValueError('need both curve and onset observations on complete training rows')
    y = np.r_[eps[cr, ck], rate[rr]]
    channels = np.r_[ck, np.full(rr.size, t.size)]
    blocks = [np.flatnonzero(channels == key) for key in np.unique(channels)]
    tc = t[ck, None]
    rows, inv = np.unique(np.r_[cr, rr], return_inverse=True)
    ci, ri = inv[:cr.size], inv[cr.size:]
    tail = np.r_[np.cumsum(d[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if d.size else d

    def jump(tau: np.ndarray, pick: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        kernel = np.exp(-tail[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-d[:, None] / tau)
        return p[pick, None] - h[pick] @ kernel

    def design(tau: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        j = jump(tau, rows)
        relax = -np.expm1(-tc / tau)
        return np.vstack((np.column_stack((j[ci] * relax, cov[cr] * tc,
                                           ov[cr] * tc[:, 0], work[cr] * relax[:, 0])),
                          np.column_stack((j[ri] / tau, cov[rr], ov[rr], work[rr] / tau[0]))))

    active = np.r_[np.ones(nh, bool), np.any(design(np.array([lo, hi]))[:, -2:] != 0., axis=0)]
    if y.size < active.sum() + 2:
        raise ValueError('too few complete training observations for the active law')
    if (not active[-2] and np.any(ov[~training] != 0.)) or (not active[-1] and np.any(work[~training] != 0.)):
        raise ValueError('prediction excites a plastic term absent from fitted observations')
    log_lo, log_hi = np.log([lo, hi])

    def unpack(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        first = log_lo + (log_hi - log_lo) * q[0]
        return np.exp([first, first + (log_hi - first) * q[1]])

    def project(q: np.ndarray, weight: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a = design(unpack(q))[:, active]
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(a * weight[:, None], y * weight, rcond=None)[0]
        return a @ w - y, w

    def optimize(start: np.ndarray, weight: np.ndarray):
        return least_squares(lambda q: weight * project(q, weight)[0], start,
                             bounds=([0., 1e-4], [1. - 1e-4, 1.]), max_nfev=100)

    weight = np.where(channels == t.size, np.sqrt(t.size), 1.)
    starts = ([.18, .35], [.32, .56], [.50, .43], [.64, .72])
    opt = min((optimize(np.asarray(q), weight) for q in starts), key=lambda fit: fit.cost)
    for _ in range(5):
        error, _ = project(opt.x, weight)
        sigma = np.empty_like(error)
        for block in blocks:
            r = error[block]
            sigma[block] = max(noise_floor, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))))
        weight = 1. / np.hypot(sigma, error / robust_cutoff)
        opt = optimize(opt.x, weight)
    tau = unpack(opt.x)
    _, coef = project(opt.x, weight)
    # Check joint sensitivity with coefficients held fixed for tau derivatives.
    steps = 1e-5 * np.eye(2)
    derivative = [((design(tau * np.exp(step))[:, active] -
                    design(tau * np.exp(-step))[:, active]) @ coef) / 2e-5 for step in steps]
    jac = np.column_stack((*derivative, design(tau)[:, active])) * weight[:, None]
    singular = np.linalg.svd(jac, compute_uv=False)
    if not opt.success or singular[-1] <= rank_rtol * singular[0]:
        raise ValueError('fit failed to converge with an identifiable active law')
    w = np.zeros(nh + 2)
    w[active] = coef
    amplitude = jump(tau, np.arange(n)) * w[:2]
    amplitude[:, 0] += work * w[-1]
    drift = cov @ w[2:nh] + ov * w[-2]
    onset = amplitude @ (1. / tau) + drift
    anchor = ~training & ~complete & np.isfinite(rate)
    drift[anchor] += rate[anchor] - onset[anchor]
    onset[anchor] = rate[anchor]
    curve = amplitude @ -np.expm1(-t[None, :] / tau[:, None]) + drift[:, None] * t
    hereditary = w[:nh] * np.r_[np.full(2, strain_scale / stress_scale), np.full(nh - 2, rate_unit)]
    plastic = w[-2:] * rate_unit / stress_scale**np.array([2, 3])
    return tau * time_scale, hereditary, plastic, e0[:, None] + strain_scale * curve, rate_unit * onset

def run_self_test():
    close = np.testing.assert_allclose
    equal = np.testing.assert_array_equal
    rng = np.random.default_rng(250)
    f, k = .01, .5

    # A wide check sweep with EMI, a narrow spot, and two wide compatible spots.
    cmd = np.array([-.8, -.3, .2, .7, .9, .3, -1., 1.])
    measured = np.r_[1.2 * cmd[:5] + .14, .9 * .3 - .04, 1.01 * cmd[-2:] + .01]
    measured[4] += .8
    labels = np.array([7]*5 + [2, 19, 19])
    groups = np.array([2, 19, 7])
    prior = np.array([[.9, -.05], [1., 0.], [1., 0.]])
    maps, local = calibrate_affine_gauges(cmd, measured, labels, groups, stress_scale=2., prior=prior)
    equal(local, [False, False, True])
    close(maps, [[.9, -.04], [1.01, .01], [1.2, .14]], atol=1e-12)
    j = rng.permutation(len(cmd))
    m2, l2 = calibrate_affine_gauges(f*cmd[j], f*measured[j], 101+labels[j], 101+groups,
                                     stress_scale=2.*f, prior=prior*[1., f])
    equal(l2, local)
    close(m2, maps*[1., f], atol=1e-12)

    n = 48
    i = np.arange(n)
    group = 10 + 7*(i % 4)
    stratum = (i // 4) % 3
    truth = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    raw = truth.copy()
    raw[[-2, -1], 0] = np.nan
    ref = np.tile((2*((i//4) % 2)-1)[:, None], (1, 3))
    x, complete = align_reference_features(raw, ref, group, stratum)
    cell = [np.nanmean(raw[(group == a) & (stratum == b), 0])
            for a in np.unique(group) for b in np.unique(stratum)]
    close(x[-2:, 0], np.mean(cell), atol=1e-12)
    gain = (1 + i % 4)[:, None]
    bias = (3 - 2*(i % 4))[:, None]
    x2, c2 = align_reference_features(gain*raw+bias, gain*ref+bias, 100-group, 10-stratum)
    close(x2, x, atol=1e-12)
    equal(c2, complete)

    sy = 2.
    h = rng.uniform(-1.6, 1.6, (n, 4))
    hold = rng.uniform(.5, 1.8, n) * np.where(i % 2, 1., -1.)
    h[i % 4 >= 2, 1] = rng.uniform(2.6, 4., size=(i % 4 >= 2).sum())
    hold[i % 4 == 1] = -rng.uniform(2.5, 3.7, size=(i % 4 == 1).sum())
    hold[i % 4 == 3] = rng.uniform(2.5, 3.7, size=(i % 4 == 3).sum())
    hold[0] = -sy
    dt = np.array([.14, .29, .57, .84])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(.09, 6., 19)]
    e0 = rng.uniform(-.01, .01, n)
    tau = np.array([.47, 2.65])
    w = np.array([.04, .026, .02, .003, -.004, .002, .005])
    wp = np.array([.055, .023])
    train = i < n-6
    kwargs = dict(time_scale=2., stress_scale=2., strain_scale=.2, yield_stress=sy, tau_bounds=(.12, 8.))

    def generate(hist, p):
        # Independent forward recurrence, with hold-only and history-only excitation.
        memory = np.zeros((n, 2))
        dose = np.zeros(n)
        for stress, step in zip(hist.T, dt):
            decay = np.exp(-step/tau)
            memory = memory*decay + stress[:, None]*(1-decay)
            dose += np.where(np.abs(stress) > sy, (np.abs(stress)-sy)**2, 0.)*step
        jumps = (p[:, None]-memory)*w[:2]
        jumps[:, 0] += wp[1]*dose*p
        drift = w[2] + truth @ w[3:]
        drift += wp[0]*np.where(np.abs(p) > sy, (np.abs(p)-sy)**2*p/np.abs(p), 0.)
        return e0[:, None] + jumps @ (1-np.exp(-t/tau[:, None])) + drift[:, None]*t, jumps @ (1/tau) + drift

    curve, onset = generate(h, hold)
    obs = np.where(train[:, None], curve, np.nan)
    # Corrupt a single curve channel and a training onset; neither sets the fitted law.
    obs[2, 8] += .4
    obs[9, 8] -= .4
    rate = onset.copy()
    rate[7] += .25
    rate[-3] += .4  # Complete prediction: this anchor must not be used.
    rate[-1] = np.nan  # Incomplete prediction: retain the imputed prior.
    expected_curve, expected_rate = curve.copy(), onset.copy()
    delta = (x[-1]-truth[-1]) @ w[3:]
    expected_curve[-1] += delta*t
    expected_rate[-1] += delta
    out = fit_predict_yield_gated_creep(h, hold, dt, t, e0, x, complete, train, obs, rate, **kwargs)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in out)
    for got, want in zip(out, (tau, w, wp, expected_curve, expected_rate)):
        close(got, want, rtol=3e-3, atol=1e-4)
    close(out[3][:, 0], e0, atol=1e-13)
    close(out[4][-2], rate[-2], atol=1e-13)

    scaled = fit_predict_yield_gated_creep(f*h, f*hold, k*dt, k*t, e0, x2, c2, train, obs, rate/k,
                 time_scale=2.*k, stress_scale=2.*f, strain_scale=.2, yield_stress=sy*f,
                 tau_bounds=(.12*k, 8.*k))
    restored = (scaled[0]/k, scaled[1]*np.r_[[f, f], np.full(5, k)],
                scaled[2]*k*np.array([f**2, f**3]), scaled[3], k*scaled[4])
    for got, want in zip(restored, out):
        close(got, want, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5)

    # Equality is sub-yield. Plastic weights must be exactly zero, not fitted.
    linear_h, linear_p = np.clip(h, -sy, sy), np.clip(hold, -sy, sy)
    curve, onset = generate(linear_h, linear_p)
    sub = fit_predict_yield_gated_creep(linear_h, linear_p, dt, t, e0, truth, np.ones(n, bool),
                    train, np.where(train[:, None], curve, np.nan), np.where(train, onset, np.nan), **kwargs)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in sub)
    equal(sub[2], [0., 0.])
    close(sub[0], tau, rtol=2e-5)
